schools.name: Harvard Business School
schools.description: HBS offers a two-year, full-time MBA Program with a general management curriculum focused on real-world practice through the case method. Known for producing leaders across consulting, finance, technology, and entrepreneurship.

curriculum.year1: Required Curriculum - Core courses in finance, leadership, marketing, operations

learningMethods.name: Case Method
learningMethods.description: Students analyze ~500 cases, taking the role of decision-maker

essays.prompt: Business-Minded: Please reflect on how your experiences have influenced your career choices and aspirations.
Leadership-Focused: What experiences have shaped how you invest in others and how you lead?
Growth-Oriented: Curiosity can be seen in many ways. Discuss how you demonstrate curiosity.

studentLife.location: 40-acre campus in Boston, MA. ~65% live on campus

schools.name: Stanford Graduate School of Business
schools.description: Stanford GSB offers a two-year MBA program emphasizing innovation, entrepreneurship, and leadership. Known for its strength in technology, venture capital, and social impact.

curriculum.year2: Full range of electives and experiential learning

learningMethods.name: Global Experiences
learningMethods.description: International study trips and global immersion programs

essays.prompt: What matters most to you, and why?
Why Stanford? Describe your aspirations and how your Stanford GSB experience will help you realize them.

schools.name: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
schools.description: Wharton offers a flexible 20-month MBA program with 21 majors including 9 STEM-designated options. Known for finance, entrepreneurship, and analytical rigor.

curriculum.structure: Flexible core with 21 majors to choose from

centers.name: Stevens Center for Innovation in Finance

essays.prompt: What are your career goals for the first three to five years after completing your MBA, and how will those build towards your long-term professional goals?
Taking into consideration your background – personal, professional, and/or academic – how do you plan to add meaningful value to the Wharton community?

schools.name: University of Chicago Booth School of Business
schools.description: Booth offers the world's most flexible MBA with freedom to customize curriculum, take risks, and define your impact. Known for analytical rigor and data-driven decision making.

curriculum.structure: Flexible curriculum - design your own path
curriculum.description: No majors required, complete freedom in course selection after core

centers.name: Rustandy Center for Social Sector Innovation

essays.prompt: How will the Booth MBA help you achieve your immediate and long-term post-MBA career goals?

recommendations.preferredFrom: One from current supervisor, one from professional contact

schools.name: MIT Sloan School of Management
schools.description: MIT Sloan's two-year MBA program emphasizes innovation, entrepreneurship, and data-driven leadership. Known for technology, operations, and analytical excellence.

curriculum.structure: Core curriculum followed by flexible electives

learningMethods.name: Action Learning Labs
learningMethods.description: Hands-on consulting projects with real companies

learningMethods.name: Global Entrepreneurship Lab
learningMethods.description: Work with startups in emerging markets

centers.name: Martin Trust Center for MIT Entrepreneurship

essays.prompt: Cover letter seeking a place in the MIT Sloan MBA program

recommendations.preferredFrom: Professional contact, ideally manager or supervisor

schools.name: Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University
schools.description: Kellogg offers 1-year and 2-year MBA options with 14 majors and 4 pathways. Known for marketing, management, and collaborative culture. Best known for Product Marketing and PM roles.

essays.prompt: Intentionality is a key aspect of what makes our graduates successful Kellogg leaders. Help us understand your journey by articulating your motivations for pursuing an MBA, the specific goals you aim to achieve, and why you believe now is the right moment.
Describe a specific professional experience where you had to make a difficult decision. Reflecting on this experience, identify the values that guided your decision-making process.

schools.name: Columbia Business School
schools.description: Columbia offers August-entry (2-year) and January-entry (16-month) MBA programs in the heart of New York City. Known for finance, media, real estate, and NYC connections.

curriculum.structure: Core curriculum followed by curriculum pathways
curriculum.pathways: Value Investing, Media, Tech, Entrepreneurship, and more

learningMethods.name: Chazen Global Immersion
learningMethods.description: International study tours led by CBS faculty

learningMethods.name: Master Classes
learningMethods.description: Hands-on consulting projects with NYC companies

centers.name: Heilbrunn Center for Graham & Dodd Investing
Paul Milstein Center for Real Estate

essays.prompt: Through your resume and recommendations, we have a clear sense of your professional path to date. What are your career goals over the next 3–5 years, and what's your long-term dream job?
The Phillips Pathway for Inclusive Leadership (PPIL) is central to the CBS experience. Describe how you have worked to advance DEI in your professional or personal life.
Why do you feel Columbia Business School is a good fit for you?
